text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The day Vodka leaves for overseas is finally here. However, trying to look cool right before her departure, she ends up spraining her ankle.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Daiwa Scarlet becomes fed up with Vodka when she learns the trip abroad has fallen through.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: They have a serious conversation about their rivalry, and Daiwa Scarlet tells Vodka that seeing her run in the Japanese Derby lit a fire inside her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: In order to race against Daiwa Scarlet, Vodka decides to continue racing in Japan. After a few days of rest, she decides to set her sights on the Shuka Sho, where her rival awaits.
